title: EPUB signature
summary: An EPUB file is a ZIP archive containing XHTML content, CSS, images, and a container.xml (META-INF/container.xml pointing to the OPF package document). The magic is the standard ZIP signature 0x50 0x4B 0x03 0x04.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: EPUB contains: META-INF/container.xml, OEBPS/content.opf, XHTML files, CSS, images.
EPUB is the standard ebook format.
EPUB 3 is the current version (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
